Tax Depreciation — Community (OCA register)

Puts the Czech/Slovak tax depreciation board on assets of the OCA asset register used on Odoo Community.

Version19.0.1.5.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresaccount_asset_tax, account_asset_management
Extended byl10n_sk_account_asset_profile
This module is part of a family documented in one place. The full guide: account_asset_tax

Adds the Tax Depreciation tab to assets of the OCA account_asset_management register, tax depreciation defaults to asset profiles, the Book vs Tax Depreciation analysis, the Compute Tax Depreciation batch action (asset list Action menu and Accounting → Configuration), and records the tax disposal when an asset is removed in the register. The entry value is the asset's purchase value and the in-service date its depreciation start date.

Install it together with account_asset_tax, account_asset_management and the country data (l10n_sk_account_asset_tax / l10n_cz_account_asset_tax); it does not install itself. It cannot be combined with the Enterprise bridge, account_asset_tax_ee (delivered separately).
